title: Assistant Manager – Production & Machining Operations (Supervisor)
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

Relevant experience to lead shop floor production activities and ensure the achievement of production, quality, delivery, and safety objectives. Managing shift operations, manpower deployment, machine utilization, process improvement, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives within the machine shop.

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machining operations, CNC programming, production planning, OEE monitoring, and team management in a high-volume manufacturing environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Production & Shift Management**

* Lead and oversee machine shop operations during assigned shifts to achieve production targets.
* Ensure adherence to production schedules, quality standards, and delivery commitments.
* Drive productivity improvements through effective utilization of manpower, machines, and resources.
* Monitor daily production performance and take corrective actions to eliminate bottlenecks.

### **Manpower Planning & Team Development**

* Plan and deploy manpower effectively based on production requirements.
* Train, guide, and develop operators and new employees on processes, quality standards, and safety practices.
* Build multi-skilled teams to improve operational flexibility and efficiency.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, and overall workforce performance.

### **OEE & Performance Monitoring**

* Monitor and improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* Conduct daily loss analysis and downtime reviews.
* Identify productivity losses and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency.

### **Machining Operations**

* Supervise and optimize machining processes including:

  + Vertical Machining Centers (VMC)
  + Special Purpose Machines (SPM)
  + Expansion Honing
  + Single Pass Honing
  + Grinding Operations
* Ensure process capability, dimensional accuracy, and adherence to process parameters.
* Support cycle time reduction and process optimization initiatives.

### **CNC Programming & Technical Support**

* Provide technical guidance on CNC machine programming and setup.
* Work with machine controls including:

  + Fanuc
  + Siemens
  + Brother
* Support program optimization and troubleshooting activities to improve machine performance.

### **Troubleshooting & Maintenance Coordination**

* Diagnose and resolve machine-related issues and process deviations.
* Coordinate with maintenance teams for effective breakdown management.
* Implement preventive measures to minimize machine downtime and improve equipment reliability.

### **Jigs, Fixtures & Tooling Management**

* Ensure availability and proper utilization of jigs, fixtures, tools, and gauges.
* Support development and improvement of machining fixtures and tooling.
* Monitor tool life and recommend improvements to enhance productivity.

### **Technical Documentation**

* Interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and process requirements.
* Develop and maintain:

  + Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  + Work Instructions
  + Process Flow Diagrams
  + Production and Process Documentation
* Ensure process documentation is regularly updated and effectively communicated.

### **Quality Management**

* Ensure compliance with customer and internal quality requirements.
* Analyze defects, rejections, and process deviations.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement corrective actions using quality tools such as 5 Why Analysis and Fishbone Diagram.
* Drive initiatives for defect reduction and process improvement.

### **Safety & Compliance**

* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with EHS standards.
* Conduct regular safety observations and risk assessments.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, statutory requirements, and 5S practices.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.

### **Reporting & Analysis**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production reports.
* Analyze production, quality, downtime, and manpower data using Excel.
* Prepare management presentations and operational reviews using PowerPoint.
* Track KPIs and recommend action plans for performance improvement.

### **Specification**

* B.E. / B Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent.
* 8-12 years of experience in machine shop operations within the automotive or engineering manufacturing industry.

* Leadership and team management.
* Decision-making and problem-solving.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills.
* High focus on quality, safety, and operational excellence.

title: Benefits Operations Administrator
description:
**Our Story**

At Alight, we believe a company’s success starts with its people. Alight embraces values that come directly from our people – purposeful, human, united and growth-minded – reflecting our inclusive culture and promise that our clients expect. We are passionate about connecting purpose with impact. Alight empowers clients to build a healthier and more financially secure workforce by unifying the benefits ecosystem across health, wealth, wellbeing, navigation, and absence management.

**Our Benefits**

With a comprehensive total rewards package, Alight offers programs and plans that support your mind, body, wallet, and life. Benefits include health, starting Day One. Additionally, Alight colleagues enjoy wellbeing programs, retirement plans, and career growth opportunities – all within a thriving global organization.

**Great Place to Work**

Thanks to the work of every colleague, Alight has received multiple awards of recognition including “Great Place to Work” for the past 7 years and Fortune’s “Best Companies to Work For.” To learn more about our company culture and awards **Click Here.**

We invite you to join our team! Learn more at careers.alight.com.

**Designation-Benefits Operations Administrator (BOA)**

**Key Expectations**

* Process all activities related to client benefit plans with high accuracy and timeliness. Execution of wealth delivery processes in accordance with documented Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
* Consistently meet or exceed client Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Develop a strong understanding of client plan provisions and related documentation.
* Prioritize work effectively to respond to client and participant needs.
* Ensure adherence to predefined procedures, process guidelines, and compliance standards
* The colleague will support day‑to‑day client operations, resolves participant and processing issues within defined guidelines, and escalates exceptions or risks as appropriate
* Actively participate in daily huddles and status meetings to ensure smooth operations.

**Required Skills**

* US Pension / 401k / Payroll processing skills
* Process documentation & SOP creation
* Accountability & ownership.
* Analytical & Critical thinking skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills are important.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to handle transaction-based processing.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross functional teams (CS, Tech, Shared Services)
* Ability to manage workload in a deadline‑driven environment
* Proficiency in Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, IF formulas, pivot tables)
* Experience with AI tools in a professional setting preferred

**Role Description**

The **Benefits Operations Administrator (BOA)** is responsible for processing all activities related to client benefits plans as configured in organizational tools, while consistently meeting and exceeding client SLAs.

The role requires developing a strong understanding of client plan provisions, identifying opportunities for knowledge enhancement, and delivering work to high standards of quality and timeliness. The BOA is expected to prioritize work effectively, respond to client and participant needs in a timely manner, and ensure that all knowledge repositories, SOPs, and supporting documentation are current and accurate.

The incumbent conducts research, resolves, and responds to participant issues and inquiries using the case management tool, and collaborates closely with Customer Service, Technology, and other shared services teams for timely issue resolution.

Adherence to predefined procedures and process guidelines is critical to ensure performance parameters are consistently met or exceeded against SLA targets.

**Operations Processing & Execution**

* Ensure all processing is completed according to documented client requirements and quality standards
* Document work completed and provide daily updates in assigned task management tools (e.g., Jira)

**Quality & Compliance**

* Support quality checks and remediation efforts
* Ensure all actions are properly documented to support audit and governance needs
* Participate in corrective actions and improvement initiatives resulting from issue identification

**Continuous Improvement**

* Provide inputs and recommendations for process improvements based on recurring issues or inefficiencies
* Maintain awareness of process changes and ensure timely adoption once changes go live

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Proactive communication on situations, risks, and work status with internal team members
* Respond to internal requests for information or clarification in a timely and professional manner
* Active participation in team huddles

**Education & Experience**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline

**Experience:**

* 1 – 2 years of experience in US pension / 401k / payroll administration are preferred.

**Application and Interview**

By applying for a position with Alight, you understand that, should you be made an offer, it will be contingent on your undergoing and successfully completing a background check consistent with Alight’s employment policies. Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: Government ID validation, education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position.

Alight requires all virtual interviews to be conducted on video. Please be aware that Alight is a camera-on culture and may require occasional travel to one of our physical office locations.

**Our commitment to Inclusion**

We celebrate differences and believe in fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. We know that diverse teams are stronger, more innovative, and more successful.

At Alight, we welcome and embrace all individuals, regardless of their background, and are dedicated to creating a culture that enables every employee to thrive. Join us in building a brighter, more inclusive future.

As part of this commitment, Alight will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation for the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact alightcareers@alight.com.

**Equal Opportunity Policy Statement**

Alight is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against anyone based on sex, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital or domestic partner status, citizenship, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics or conduct covered by federal, state, or local law. In addition, we take affirmative action to employ disabled persons, disabled veterans, and other covered veterans.

Alight provides reasonable accommodation to the known limitations of otherwise qualified employees and applicants for employment with disabilities and sincerely held religious beliefs, practices and observances, unless doing so would result in undue hardship. Applicants for employment may request reasonable accommodations/modifications by contacting their recruiter.

**Authorization to work in the Employing Country**

Applicants for employment in the country in which they are applying (Employing Country) must have work authorization that does not, now or in the future, require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the Employing Country and with Alight.

Note, this job description does not restrict management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job to other entities; including but not limited to subsidiaries, partners, or purchasers of Alight business units.

We offer you a competitive total rewards package, continuing education & training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization.

title: Production Manager– Medical Devices
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Production Manager to oversee daily manufacturing operations for medical disposable products such as IV Sets, BT Sets, Nasals cannula, mask, infusion category and Anesthesia Products. The ideal candidate will have strong technical knowledge of assembly line operations, clean room practices, and proven expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and 5S methodologies, along with the ability to manage a workforce of 50+ employees efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

Production & Assembly Operations

* Oversee end to end assembly operations of IV Sets, BT Sets, infusion cateogry and Anaesthesia products, ensuring adherence to SOPs and quality standards.
* Plan, schedule, and monitor daily production targets to meet dispatch and delivery timelines.
* Ensure smooth shop floor operations across all production lines with minimal downtime.

Clean Room & Compliance

* Ensure strict compliance with clean room protocols, hygiene standards, and GMP practices during assembly and packaging.
* Monitor environmental conditions (temperature, humidity, particle count) in clean room areas as per regulatory requirements.

Process Improvement

* Implement and drive Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma initiatives to reduce waste, rework, and cycle time.
* Apply 5S principles across the shop floor to maintain a safe, organized, and efficient work environment.
* Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) for continuous improvement.

Manpower & Team Management

* Manage, train, and supervise a workforce of 50+ production staff/operators across shifts.
* Plan manpower allocation and control manpower cost in line with production requirements.
* Conduct performance reviews, motivate teams, and maintain discipline on the shop floor.

KPI & Cost Management

* Define, track, and maintain key production KPIs (output, rejection rate, efficiency, downtime, OEE, etc.).
* Conduct cost analysis for production processes and identify opportunities for cost reduction.
* Prepare and present daily/weekly/monthly production and performance reports to management.

Quality & Documentation

* Coordinate with the Quality Assurance/Quality Control team to minimize rejections and ensure product compliance.
* Maintain accurate production records, batch documentation, and audit-readiness at all times.

Qualification

* Diploma / B.Tech / B.Sc in relevant field (Biomedical, B. Pharma, B.Sc. Biotechnology, or related discipline).
* Additional certification in Lean/Six Sigma (Green Belt/Yellow Belt) preferred.

Experience

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in a medical device manufacturing/production environment, with at least 1–2 years in a supervisory/managerial role.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented **Tele-Sales Operations Manager** to manage and drive the performance of our call center tele-sales team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for achieving sales targets, managing team productivity, monitoring call quality, improving conversion rates, and ensuring an excellent customer experience. The candidate should have strong leadership, analytical, and operational management skills, preferably in a high-volume tele-sales or customer contact center environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**1. Tele-Sales Operations Management**

* Manage day-to-day tele-sales operations and ensure achievement of daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
* Develop and implement strategies to improve lead conversion, revenue generation, and overall sales productivity.
* Monitor lead allocation, follow-ups, call volumes, and sales pipeline performance.
* Ensure effective utilization of leads and minimize lead leakage.

**2. Team Management and Leadership**

* Lead, motivate, and manage Team Leaders, Supervisors, and Tele-Sales Executives.
* Set individual and team-level KPIs and monitor performance against targets.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching sessions, and sales training.
* Identify performance gaps and implement corrective action plans to improve productivity.

**3. Performance Monitoring and MIS**

* Track key performance indicators, including:
  + Calls per day and agent productivity
  + Lead-to-sale conversion ratio
  + Revenue and sales target achievement
  + Average handling time (AHT)
  + Call quality and customer satisfaction
  + Attendance, shrinkage, and attrition
* Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports to senior management.
* Use data analytics to identify bottlenecks and improve operational efficiency.

**4. Quality Assurance and Customer Experience**

* Monitor call recordings and ensure adherence to approved calling scripts and sales processes.
* Ensure professional customer interaction, accurate product communication, and effective objection handling.
* Coordinate with the Quality and Training teams to improve sales pitch quality and customer engagement.
* Handle escalations and ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.

**5. Process Improvement and Compliance**

* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) for tele-sales operations.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, customer data protection requirements, and applicable telemarketing regulations.
* Identify opportunities to optimize workflows, reduce operational costs, and improve team efficiency.
* Coordinate with CRM, IT, HR, Quality, and Training teams to ensure smooth operations.

**6. Recruitment, Training, and Retention**

* Coordinate with HR and Talent Acquisition for manpower planning and timely hiring.
* Support onboarding, product training, and continuous skill development.
* Monitor absenteeism and attrition and implement employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Build a performance-driven culture focused on accountability and target achievement.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**
--------------------------------------

* Graduate in any discipline; an MBA in Sales, Marketing, or Operations will be an advantage.
* 5–8 years of experience in tele-sales, contact center, or call center operations, with at least 2–3 years in a managerial role.
* Proven experience managing high-volume outbound tele-sales teams.
* Strong understanding of sales conversion, lead management, objection handling, and target-driven operations.
* Hands-on experience with CRM tools, dialers, Excel, and MIS reporting.
* Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage large teams in a fast-paced, target-oriented environment.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
-------------------------------------

* Achievement of monthly sales and revenue targets.
* Improvement in lead conversion and agent productivity.
* Reduction in lead leakage, absenteeism, and employee attrition.
* Improvement in call quality and customer satisfaction.
* Effective manpower utilization and operational cost control.
* Timely and accurate submission of operational MIS reports.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**
-------------------------------

The ideal candidate should be a proactive leader with a strong sales mindset, excellent team management capabilities, and a proven track record of delivering business results through tele-sales operations. Experience in healthcare, wellness, Ayurveda, D2C, e-commerce, or other consumer-focused businesses will be preferred.

title: Team Leader - Operations
description:
The **Role**

This is not a routine policy\-processing or supervisory role.

The Operations Lead will own the complete operational lifecycle across policy issuance,

endorsements, cancellations, SLA/TAT, dealer support, insurer coordination, operational

escalations, team productivity and technology\-enabled process automation.

The person will lead the L2 Operations function and work closely with Sales, Finance, Product

and Technology teams to ensure that operational issues do not become business bottlenecks.

The ideal candidate is a hands\-on operator, problem solver and process owner who can

manage people, processes, partners and technology together.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Motor Insurance Operations

Own day\-to\-day execution and quality of:

**New Motor Policy Issuance**

**Renewals**

**Endorsements**

**Cancellations**

**Policy corrections**

**Break\-in cases**

**Inspection coordination**

**Documentation and verification**

**Premium / coverage / add\-on validation**

**Policy servicing and related operational requests**

Ensure accuracy, compliance, productivity and SLA adherence across the complete process.

2\. SLA \& Operations Management

Own operational SLA/TAT from case initiation to closure.

Monitor real\-time operational performance and pending cases.

Identify SLA risks and intervene before they become escalations.

Track SLA performance across insurers, portals, dealers, regions and business channels.

Establish structured reason, category and sub\-category classification for operational

exceptions.

Conduct RCA for SLA breaches and recurring operational issues.

Drive corrective and preventive actions.

Maintain operational dashboards and performance reviews.

Ensure consistent SLA adherence across the L2 function.

The expectation is to prevent SLA breaches—not simply report them.

3\. Technology\-Enabled Operations \& Automation

Lead the evolution of a technology\-enabled insurance operations model.

Drive adoption and optimization of AI/ML\-enabled and intelligent workflow solutions

across policy issuance and servicing.

Identify repetitive, high\-volume and error\-prone processes for automation.

Work with Product \& Technology teams to convert operational requirements into

scalable solutions.

Monitor automation effectiveness, processing accuracy and operational throughput.

Analyse exceptions and recurring failure patterns and drive resolution.

Continuously reduce manual dependency and operational turnaround time.

Ensure appropriate operational fallback processes for technology or system exceptions.

The goal: faster processing, higher accuracy, lower operational dependency and scalable

growth.

4\. Insurer, Aggregator \& Portal Management

Act as the operational SPOC for insurers, aggregators and external operational partners.

Coordinate with insurers and aggregators for issuance, servicing and escalation matters.

Manage insurer/portal\-related operational issues.

Maintain appropriate redundancy and fallback processes for critical operational

dependencies.

Track insurer\-wise operational performance and SLA.

Ensure timely escalation and closure of unresolved issues.

Work with Technology/Product teams to address recurring portal/process issues.

5\. Dealer \& Sales Operations Support

Own Operations as a focal point for Sales and Dealer support.

Resolve dealer operational queries and escalations.

Support Sales on issuance, endorsement, cancellation and servicing requirements.

Define and maintain Sales–Operations escalation processes and response SLAs.

Ensure dealer issues are tracked through closure.

Identify recurring dealer issues and eliminate root causes.

Work closely with Sales to ensure operational readiness for business growth.

6\. L2 Team Leadership \& Productivity

Lead the L2 Operations team and own its performance.

Allocate workload based on volume and priority.

Set individual and team productivity expectations.

Monitor workload, capacity, productivity and quality.

Conduct daily/weekly operational reviews.

Coach and develop team members.

Identify performance gaps and initiate corrective actions/PIPs where required.

Manage shift planning, leave and operational coverage.

Build a high\-accountability and high\-productivity culture.

7\. Wallet, Recharge \& Operational Reconciliation

Coordinate and own operational resolution for:

Dealer wallet/recharge issues

Recharge failures

Balance discrepancies

Policy\-to\-wallet reconciliation

Dealer payment\-related operational queries

Coordination with Finance on operational reconciliation and settlement issues

8\. MIS, Analytics \& Operational Governance

Establish a reliable Operations Control \& Reporting framework covering:

Policy volumes

SLA/TAT

Pending cases and ageing

Error/quality rates

Productivity

Insurer/portal performance

Dealer/region performance

Escalations

Root\-cause trends

Automation effectiveness

Operational exceptions  
Strong Excel / Power BI / SQL / analytical capability will be an advantage.

**Key Success Metrics**  
The candidate will be measured on measurable business outcomes, including:

* SLA/TAT adherence
* Policy issuance accuracy
* Endorsement \& cancellation TAT
* Pending\-case ageing
* Escalation resolution time
* Team productivity
* Dealer support SLA
* Insurer/partner issue resolution
* Operational error rate
* Automation\-enabled processing efficiency
* Reduction in manual intervention
* Process improvement and cost efficiency

What We're Looking For

**Must Have**

**5–8 years of experience in Motor/General Insurance Operations.**

* **Strong hands\-on experience in policy issuance and servicing**
* **Good understanding of endorsements, cancellations, renewals, corrections and break\-in cases**
* **Proven experience managing SLA/TAT and high\-volume operations**
* **2–3\+ years of team\-handling/L2 management experience**
* **Experience coordinating with multiple insurers/insurance partners**
* **Strong escalation and stakeholder\-management skills**
* **Strong Excel/MIS and analytical capability**
* **Ability to identify operational bottlenecks and drive RCA/corrective action**
* **Ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment**

Pay: ₹500,000\.00 \- ₹900,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Deputy Manager - Operations & Maintenance CNG
description:
### **Responsibilities**


**CNG O\&M Engineer \- O4**


**Operational Support:**


* Assist in the day\-to\-day operations of CNG stations, ensuring the efficient and reliable delivery of services.
* Monitor the performance of equipment and systems, conducting routine inspections to identify and address any operational issues.
* Support the implementation of operational strategies and procedures developed by the O\&M Lead to optimize system performance and reliability.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory, safety, and environmental standards during operations, reporting any deviations to the O\&M Lead.
* Provide technical support during the integration of new systems or equipment into existing CNG infrastructure.


**Maintenance Execution:**


* Execute preventive and corrective maintenance activities on CNG station equipment, ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
* Utilize diagnostic tools and techniques to monitor the condition of CNG station infrastructure, identifying maintenance needs.
* Coordinate with contractors and service providers to carry out maintenance tasks, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of all maintenance activities, inspections, and repairs, ensuring these are readily available for review.
* Implement best practices in maintenance management, contributing to continuous improvements in efficiency and effectiveness.


**Technical Problem Solving:**


* Troubleshoot technical issues that arise during operations or maintenance activities, providing timely and effective solutions.
* Analyze system data and performance metrics to identify potential areas for improvement and to prevent future operational disruptions.
* Collaborate with the O\&M Lead to develop and implement engineering solutions that enhance the reliability and efficiency of CNG systems.
* Participate in technical meetings and reviews, offering insights and recommendations to optimize project outcomes.


**Safety and Compliance:**


* Ensure all maintenance and operational activities comply with safety regulations and industry standards, minimizing the risk of accidents or incidents.
* Participate in safety audits and inspections, identifying potential hazards and implementing measures to mitigate risks.
* Assist in the development of safety protocols and procedures, ensuring they are adhered to by all team members and contractors.
* Prepare safety documentation, such as risk assessments and method statements, to support safe operations and maintenance practices.


**Documentation and Reporting:**


* Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, including maintenance logs, inspection reports, and equipment manuals.
* Provide regular updates to the O\&M Lead on the status of ongoing maintenance activities and any issues encountered.
* Assist in the preparation of operational and maintenance reports for senior management, highlighting key findings and areas for improvement.
* Ensure that all documentation is organized, accessible, and complies with internal and external audit requirements.


**Team Collaboration and Communication:**


* Work closely with other engineers, technicians, and team members to ensure smooth execution of maintenance and operational activities.
* Communicate clearly and effectively with contractors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure that project objectives and timelines are met.
* Participate in team meetings, providing updates on engineering activities and contributing to discussions on improving operational efficiency.
* Liaise with other departments as needed to ensure integrated and effective operations of CNG stations.


**Continuous Improvement and Learning:**


* Stay informed about the latest developments in engineering practices, technologies, and industry standards relevant to CNG operations.
* Identify opportunities to improve maintenance processes and practices, proposing and implementing changes that enhance performance.
* Participate in training and professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge, ensuring continued growth within the team.
* Share knowledge and insights with the team, contributing to a culture of continuous learning and improvement.


**KEY STAKEHOLDERS**


**Internal Stakeholders:**


* Regional office
* Corporate office
* TechnoCommercial Team
* HSE Team
* Projects


**External Stakeholders:**


* Vendors
* Contractors
* Local authorities
* Regulatory bodies
* Consultants

### **Qualifications**


**Educational Qualification:**



Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.


**Work Experience:**



4\+ years of experience in gas station construction operations and maintenance


**Preferred Industry:**



Experience in the gas distribution, oil and energy, or utilities sectors.

title: Global L&D Operations Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


Our Global Learning \& Development (L\&D) Operations function is a key enabler of our firm’s success, ensuring learning programs are delivered with quality, consistency, and scalability across regions and cohorts.


You will lead a team of operations professionals and ensure effective, scalable execution of learning processes, including learner lifecycle management, system integrity, capacity planning, and operational excellence aligned to global L\&D priorities.

 **Responsibilities**

* Manage LMS operations and end\-to\-end learner lifecycle
* Allocate resources and manage capacity planning
* Ensure SLA adherence, KPI performance, and data accuracy
* Act as escalation point for operational and system issues
* Improve workflows and enhance system efficiency
* Coach and develop team members
* Maintain system \& data integrity and reporting quality

  

What You'll Bring

* 6\+ years of relevant experience in L\&D operations, systems, program management, or service environments
* Proven experience managing operational processes, learner lifecycle, or system\-driven workflows
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop individuals or small teams in operational environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage expectations and ensure process alignment
* Experience working with systems (e.g., LMS) and ensuring data accuracy and process compliance
* Strong organizational and planning skills, including capacity and workload management
* Continuous improvement mindset focused on efficiency, scalability, and operational excellence

  

Who You'll Work With


You will work with global L\&D teams, business stakeholders, faculty, vendors, and cross\-functional partners to deliver and continuously improve learning experiences.

  

Additional info

**You’re Good At**

* Managing systems, workflows, and operational processes including LMS
* Ensuring data accuracy, governance and adherence to SLAs
* Handling operational escalations effectively
* Driving efficiency and consistency
* Balancing capacity and demand
* Developing team capability

  

"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.


For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.


We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
